# Every Go module in this repository, one per line.
#
#   published <dir>  released together at one version and tagged "<dir>/v<version>"
#                    ("." is the root module, tagged "v<version>")
#   private   <dir>  built and tested by CI, never tagged or imported by users
#
# This file is the only module list. Release, verification and CI read it;
# release.sh validate fails when a tracked go.mod is missing from it.
